technique_name: Describe the concept of quantum entanglement.
description: Quantum entanglement is a phenomenon where two particles can be entangled, or connected, so that the conditions of each particle are related even at a large distance. This means that each particle is instantaneously aware of what changes have been made to the other particle, even though they may be separated by vast distances.
